title: AuK Speech Studio
hero: Direct a voice, down to the breath.
description: Generation, content repair, acoustic control, emotion, nonverbal performance, restoration, and source separation through AuK's native unified message model. Every structured control remains visible before it becomes an instruction.
guide: The full AuK task map, local Qwen encoder, Base/Flash sampling rules, private Vox-compatible route, and exact model readiness contract.
setup_steps: Confirm the downloader-created `ckpts/AuK` and `ckpts/Qwen2.5-Omni-3B` trees pass the setup audit.
Optionally copy `.env.local.example` to `.env.local` and name a loopback OpenAI-compatible model for Prompt Enhancer.
Run `./startwithuv.sh` for this studio and its private Vox-compatible endpoint on port 8260.
Use `./starthttp.sh` when only the server/API surface is wanted; it launches the same native adapter without opening a browser.

modes.title: Voice clone TTS
modes.short: Speak new text in a supplied reference voice.
modes.description: AuK zero-shot TTS: condition on a reference clip, preserve the speaker identity, and speak entirely new text with optional expressive direction.
modes.recipe: The reference clip supplies identity. Text, duration, and optional expressive direction stay explicit.

fields.label: Reference voice
fields.hint: A few seconds of dry, single-speaker speech works best.

fields.label: Target duration
fields.hint: Set directly, or approximate the delivery length from the script.

modes.preview_template: Say the following with the same voice: “{{target_text}}”. Target duration: {{target_seconds}}.

modes.title: Directed TTS
modes.short: Design a voice and performance without a reference clip.
modes.description: AuK instruction-only TTS with a complete voice brief, expressive emoji mixer, pace, warmth, energy, breathiness, and director's note.
modes.recipe: This is the full showcase-style performance desk: the sliders become visible natural-language nuance, not secret numeric conditioning.

fields.label: Voice design
fields.placeholder: A poised middle-aged narrator with a resonant, lightly textured baritone…
fields.hint: Age, register, timbre, diction, physicality, attitude, scene, and delivery can all be described.

modes.preview_template: Based on this voice and performance description — {{voice_description}} — say: “{{target_text}}”. Target duration: {{target_seconds}}.

modes.title: Speech content repair
modes.short: Replace spoken words while preserving voice and surrounding audio.
modes.description: Edit a specific phrase in spoken audio. The original and replacement are kept separate so the model instruction and output manifest remain auditable.

fields.label: Words to replace
fields.placeholder: but accepting what we cannot have

fields.label: Replacement words
fields.placeholder: and living well with dreams unmet

modes.preview_template: Replace “{{original_text}}” with “{{replacement_text}}” while preserving the speaker and surrounding delivery.

modes.title: Lyric repair
modes.short: Replace sung words while preserving the vocal performance.
modes.description: AuK's vocal-content edit path for an isolated singing recording. Separate vocals first when the source still contains accompaniment.
modes.preview_template: Replace “{{original_text}}” with “{{replacement_text}}” in the lyrics while preserving melody, singer, and phrasing.

modes.title: Pitch shift
modes.short: Raise or lower speech by exact semitones.
modes.description: The canonical AuK pitch-edit task with a signed semitone control and source-length output.

fields.label: Pitch change
fields.hint: Negative lowers pitch; positive raises it.

modes.preview_template: Change pitch by {{semitones}} semitones and preserve content, voice, and duration.

modes.title: Speech rate
modes.short: Change delivery speed with duration-aware output.
modes.description: Adjust speaking rate from half-speed to double-speed. The adapter computes the target duration from the real uploaded clip.
modes.preview_template: Adjust the speech speed to {{speed_factor}}× while preserving the speaker and content.

modes.title: Volume edit
modes.short: Raise or lower level by an explicit dB amount.
modes.description: The canonical AuK volume-edit instruction, with a safety ceiling applied only if generated peaks exceed it.
modes.preview_template: Change volume by {{gain_db}} dB and preserve content, speaker, and duration.

modes.title: Emotion performance
modes.short: Blend the full published emotion vocabulary.
modes.description: Preserve words and voice while redirecting the emotional performance. Emoji sliders expose happy, angry, sad, fearful, surprised, disgusted, calm, and excited—with intensity and secondary delivery controls.
modes.preview_template: Re-perform the line while preserving its words and speaker identity.

modes.title: Timbre redesign
modes.short: Change vocal character without changing the script.
modes.description: Describe the destination timbre in natural language and optionally refine the expressive performance around it.

fields.label: Destination timbre
fields.placeholder: A deep, calm voice with clear diction, steady pacing, and reflective weight…

modes.preview_template: Keep the spoken content unchanged and change the timbre to: “{{timbre_description}}”.

modes.title: Accent direction
modes.short: Remove or redirect accent while preserving identity.
modes.description: De-accent into a neutral target or name an intended pronunciation standard while preserving speaker, words, and duration.

fields.label: Target pronunciation
fields.placeholder: neutral General American English / standard Mandarin…

modes.preview_template: Remove the regional accent and use {{accent_target}}, while preserving the speaker's voice, content, and duration.

modes.title: Nonverbal choreography
modes.short: Add or remove breaths, laughs, coughs, sighs, and more.
modes.description: Stack multiple visible nonverbal edits: breath, laugh, cough, sigh, sneeze, pause, humming, hiss, sobbing, gasp, sharp inhale, or filler—globally or around exact anchor words.

fields.label: Target duration
fields.hint: Useful when adding events makes the clip longer. Blank preserves source duration.

modes.preview_template: Preserve the words and speaker while applying the listed nonverbal edits.

modes.title: Whisper conversion
modes.short: Move cleanly between normal voice and whisper.
modes.description: Bidirectional whisper conversion while preserving speaker identity, content, and source duration.
modes.preview_template: Convert the source {{whisper_direction}} while preserving the speaker, content, and duration.

modes.title: Speech restoration
modes.short: Denoise, dereverberate, and repair damaged speech.
modes.description: Choose the exact defects to remove while preserving one or every speaker. Quality restoration covers telephone effect, muffling, clipping, dropouts, and custom damage.

fields.label: Other defect
fields.placeholder: Describe anything else that should be repaired…

modes.preview_template: Restore natural, clear speech while preserving the requested speakers.

modes.title: Speaker extraction
modes.short: Keep one speaker by order or by the words they say.
modes.description: AuK speech separation can target the first/second/etc. speaker or identify them from an exact phrase, then optionally clean noise and reverb.
modes.preview_template: Keep only the selected speaker; remove every other speaker and apply the requested cleanup.

modes.title: Vocal extraction
modes.description: The AuK music-separation path keeps the vocal and removes accompaniment; output safety prevents accidental clipping without imposing loudness normalization.

fields.label: Vocal cleanup
fields.toggle_label: Improve clarity while removing the accompaniment

modes.preview_template: Extract the singing voice and discard the accompaniment.

modes.title: Open AuK direction
modes.short: Use the native unified message interface directly.
modes.description: For valid combinations not captured by a structured desk. The instruction is recorded verbatim; source audio and duration remain explicit.
